# Probe exhaustion is not an error [S1]

The claim states that 'Probe exhaustion is not an error'. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states: 'it is not an error if a missing brick is not recorded. As long as some missing bricks are recorded, the next frame will make progress.' Probe exhaustion refers to the scenario where the hash table insert fails after the maximum number of probes (10 attempts), resulting in the missing brick not being recorded. Since the evidence defines this specific failure case as 'not an error', the claim is fully supported.
